descriptor.retrieval_description: Elongated rectangular cardboard box with flat, matte, dry surfaces and vertical corner edges. The intended contact region on the lateral faces is flat, continuous, and free of visible contamination.
descriptor.contact_region: Opposing lateral faces of the rectangular box centered vertically
descriptor.local_geometry: Flat planar surfaces meeting at distinct vertical 90-degree corner edges
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible on the front and side lateral faces shown in the image
descriptor.uncertainty: The rear face of the box is occluded from direct view, but its material and condition are reasonably inferred from the visible sides.
